description.value: Propaganda Coffee is a specialty multi-roaster café in Vancouver's Chinatown neighbourhood that rotates a curated lineup of Canadian roasters through filter, pour-over, and espresso brewing styles. Three to four coffees are available on the espresso bar at any given time, with batch brew and single-serving pour-overs highlighting different origins. Tea alternatives sourced from O5 Tea and a housemade chai round out the menu for non-coffee drinkers.

address.value: 209 East Pender Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 1T8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Propaganda Coffee is an active specialty multi-roaster café at 209 East Pender Street with matching email (igetmyfix@propagandacoffee.ca), supporting OSM address and contact data. OSM tags provide toilets=yes with toilets:access=customers and a recent check_date of 2025-11-26, though the website does not mention washrooms. Neither the website nor OSM mention bike parking, water bottle refill, or most optional amenities; OSM lists internet_access=no but this is not confirmed by website content.
concerns: No phone number listed in OSM or on website.
Bike parking and water bottle refill — both required criteria — are unconfirmed by website or OSM.
OSM reports internet_access=no (no Wi-Fi) but this is not confirmed or denied by website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate specialty coffee shop that cycling visitors would enjoy, but key required criteria (bike parking or visibility, water bottle refill) are unconfirmed by either the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct inquiry would resolve these before inclusion.
